raw_snippet: Built on the expertise of GlowTouch and its strategic acquisition of Collective Solution, UnifyCX combines advanced AI technology with tech-enabled capabilities to revolutionize the customer experience.
note: GlowTouch bought Collective Solution and the combined business was rebranded UnifyCX. Seller's banker Intrepid confirms the completed sale (Dec 2024). Price not disclosed. Date: Date UnifyCX launched and disclosed the acquisition.
